summary: email_verifier.py correctly implements format → MX → SMTP pipeline with 30-day cache. SMTP response codes are mapped correctly. cmd_import skips only hard-invalid addresses; unverifiable ones are imported with a warning. verify-queue --fix guards status == 'queued' before marking failed, so sent entries are never touched. --skip-verify preserves original import behavior. requirements.txt includes dnspython==2.6.1. No forbidden files were modified.
